svg.title: A UMAP embedding of 350 scans built from four biometry measurements, with each scan drawn as a dot whose area is its gestational age - a number the algorithm never saw. The scans lie along an arc that runs from the youngest to the oldest.
svg.text: the algorithm never saw the dates. again.
a scan's neighbours here predict its age to 0.973. the four raw measurements themselves reach 0.972.
neither axis means anything. the arc does.
embedded from BPD, HC, AC and FL. gestational age was never shown to the algorithm.
